reviews.text: We LOVE Laveen Veterinary Center. We recently transferred to them and they have been amazing with how they handle our dogs. Today I called needing flea meds for them and within 20 minutes Sarah had everything ready for us no appointment needed. She was amazing!

Our experience with Laveen Veterinary Center, particularly Dr. McKenna, has been extremely disappointing. Their website emphasizes care, compassion, and communication, yet our experience reflected quite the opposite.

Being new to Arizona, I've visited this practice three times over the past few months, and each experience has left me increasingly disappointed.

During my male cat's neuter procedure, I was told I would receive an update, yet several hours passed beyond the expected time without any communication. I had to contact the office myself.

More recently, I brought in two cats, accompanied by my daughter. Information we clearly provided was documented incorrectly in their medical records. When I brought these inaccuracies to their attention, I was told the records could not be corrected. These inaccuracies ultimately resulted in the denial of my pet insurance claim.

My third visit was a follow-up because one of my cats was not improving with the prescribed medication. After completing the intake with the veterinary technician, Dr. McKenna entered the room, and I immediately sensed irritation in her attitude. I couldn't help but feel this stemmed from my disputes with the office in the days prior regarding inaccurate medical records that had resulted in the denial of my pet insurance claim.

Rather than approaching the visit with professionalism and compassion, I felt confronted with yet more inaccurate information, this time reportedly relayed to her by the technician. When I attempted to clarify and correct that information, she rudely told me not to raise my voice. **Speaking assertively to address misinformation is not the same as being aggressive.** As a pet owner, I have every right to advocate for my animals, ask questions, correct inaccuracies, and expect to be treated with respect.

At that point, I politely took my cat from Dr. McKenna, informed her that we would be leaving, and we calmly exited the practice. No pet owner should feel uncomfortable or disrespected simply for advocating for their pet's care.

Additionally, this practice lacks transparency regarding pricing and billing. Costs are not clearly discussed upfront, and payments are awkwardly collected in the exam room using handheld devices without providing an invoice for review before payment. Receipts and invoices are only emailed after leaving the practice. Equally concerning is the lack of written discharge instructions or summaries of care. While prescribed medications are discussed, additional care instructions beyond medication are not provided. Pet owners should receive clear, written aftercare instructions to reference at home, particularly when their pets require ongoing treatment or precautions to prevent further injury. This raises serious concerns about the practice's communication and continuity of care.

Having worked in healthcare and customer service, I have reasonable expectations regarding professionalism, accurate documentation, communication, and compassion. Unfortunately, this practice has consistently failed to meet those expectations.

My overall impression is that collecting payment takes priority over customer service and building trust with pet owners. I cannot speak to their treatment of dogs, but as a cat owner, I have experienced very little compassion, warmth, or genuine concern.

**I will not return to this practice, nor would I recommend it to anyone seeking compassionate, transparent, and professional veterinary care.**

Absolutely 💙 Laveen Veterinary Center! From Kayla, to Holly, to Dr Ware & everyone in between... all of them are fantastic and truly care about our pets. 75% of mine are overly nervous and grumpy but they are so good with Olive, Opie, & even Rosco! Rusty is easy!  They care so much and walk you through things that need explaining so well that they feel like family. I 💙 that Laveen has such a great vet center!! Not to mention, they immerse themselves in the community. Check them out!
Love, love, love them!  They take care of all my fur babies and provide such professional and wonderful care!  Highly recommend.

I love this place and everyone here! The staff is always so sweet and welcoming! Dr Aguilar is AMAZING adore her so much and the way she cares for my dog Zoey. Dr McKenna is also an angel and I love how informative they are with me regarding any questions I have. I couldn’t have picked a better place to have my girl brought to for the last almost 6 years of her life! I’ve been coming to this veterinary clinic since they were on 35th and Baseline next to the donut spot. Nothing but great things to say about everyone here and our experiences, thank you!

Such an incredible experience during a tragic loss of one of our Fur babies. Our cat got very ill very suddenly and when we took him in he was handled with such loving care. When the decision was made to have him put to sleep the vet and the vet techs were so compassionate. One even gave him a kiss on his head and told him how sweat he was and how sorry they were. Today we even received a card in the mail where the Vet and Techs all signed their condolences messages.

Our usual vet where we take our Lab doesn't treat cats so this was our first time to Laveen Vet Center. We were so impressed with our experience we will be switching our Silver Labs care to this Laveen Vet Center.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. Everyone here is the best in the business but I specifically want to shout out Jocelyn, Emma, Amy, and Dani for going above and beyond for my dog Zero. He needed to have a certain procedure done but he’s a very anxious Chihuahua and has that Chihuahua temper. They were able to provide the comfort that he needed in order to get him through everything and both Zero and I cannot be more grateful for this group of amazing people. I know it won’t do much but I hope you all know that you made a big difference in our lives and took a huge amount of stress off of our plate with your professionalism. Zero will be feeling so much better going forward. Thank you all so much! 10/10 experience
Clean and nice. Unfortunate reason to attend but appreciated the service

If you want quality vet care for your fur babies, this is the place for you! Honesty, the best Dr. I've ever experienced for my animals.  My dog has been going through a rough couple weeks. I've been working with Dr Ware with my pups care plan and highly recommend him. He takes the time to understand all the symptoms and comes up with a solid plan of action that makes the most sense for our individual needs. He personally calls with results and checks in on my pup on his days off. Him and every member of his staff genuinely care for the animals and strive for the best quality of care all around. They went above and beyond to have someone come in for my dog to get the right answers we need. They continue to go above and beyond in all the places that matter! I look FWD to continuing bringing my pup here as long as she can.
I think it's crazy they don't have the ability to cool a dog with heatstroke down and instead you have to drive 30 minutes to the nearest emergency vet.  That's crazy.

I used to have no problem paying inflated prices here because I felt like my animals genuinely received superior care.

My last visit was disappointing. I appreciated being able to book online and get an appointment reasonably quickly. However, a routine wellness visit with bloodwork and an ear swab cost more than I’ve paid for an emergency visit elsewhere, and I was not given pricing before the services were completed. The vet tech was kind, but my experience with the veterinarian felt dismissive and uncomfortable. I feel that I’ve had better experiences at other clinics for similar appointments at a third of the cost.

Previously, I would have recommended Laveen Vet Center to others without hesitation. Maybe it was just the veterinarian I saw this time, but unfortunately, I won’t be returning.

We have been bopping around to several valley vets after our favorite retired a couple years ago. Never loved any of them- either issues with office/scheduling/communication- or just not the quality of care we are looking for. Our cat had an emergency dental issue- I was able to book online with Laveen and get seen the same week. They were thorough and got his surgery booked the following week! (I have been trying to get a dental cleaning at our previous vet booked for nearly 7 months now- the fact Laveen got us in so quickly was AMAZING). They called the day before to go over all pre-operative instructions- updated me during his surgery, and during his recovery- and the vet Dr. Weber even called us the following morning to see how our cat was doing. The facility is clean, and spacious- and all the staff from reception to techs were amazing. I'm so, so so thankful we found them- they will now be our lifelong vet. I cannot thank you enough for the care you provided our Punk.

I chose to check out Laveen veterinary center to get a second opinion for my dog’s cancer. I’m so happy I did! They actually listened to my concerns and were willing to try treatment that my other vet wouldn’t. I’m happy to report the treatment is working. My entire family is so grateful. Thank you!
William, thanks for the review! Our team appreciates it.

Best vet ever! Dr.Ware has been out vet now for a few years and I will not take our dogs anywhere else. I know he will diagnose the issue correctly and give us the best treatment plan to get our girl feeling better!
Beautiful new building!  Great visit with Dr Weber and her tech. An excellent Doctor, so sweet with my 85lb pittie.  Fast, efficient and explains everything.

Dr Ware and his staff have been taking care of my fur crew over the last six years. I’ve seen Laveen Vet Center for routine check-ups, injuries, and a surgery. The entire staff is so kind and helpful. They really take their time to ensure your pet is getting the best care and keep you informed along the way. Highly recommend!
I take all three of my pups here and always receive great care/service! Highly recommend and the staff are extremely knowledgeable!
Dr. McKenna is great! Love the scheduling process and how friendly everyone is.
John, thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!
Everyone is super friendly , the place is extremely clean and welcoming, and the prices are perfect. I definitely recommend to anyone seeking a vet in the Laveen area.
Wonderful staff, very knowledgeable, highly recommend!

We love the  location on Baseline and 48th st with Dr Ray but she left 🫤
Our dog Matteo was sick and they had no availability today there so they sent us to this  location at 43rd avenue off of baseline and we met Dr  Weber who was really friendly and knowledgeable we loved her.  We would definitely consider to have her as a regular Vet for our furrySon.   We met Michelle outside who was super friendly and helpful thanks for being so thoughtful and everything you do.  Great job everyone the receptionist was nice too.  Shout out to Luci and The other tech  that helped.
Thanks for the 5 stars, Mark! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …
Thank you for your 4-star review, Kim! If there’s anything we can do to make your next visit even better, we’d love to hear your feedback.

I had to take my Basset hound in on an urgent basis. I called and was able to get my Bella in the same day.  Everyone was amazing and ensured my Bella was well cared for.  Everything was also very clean and the entire visit was efficient.

My German Shepherd injured his rear leg,he loves to jump for his favorite ball.A Doctor from here did the CCL surgery and he is 100 %.I would highly recommend this location even if you don't live close by.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Chris. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
Thanks for the review, Alexandria! Our team appreciates it.

What a wonderful veterinary clinic. We just had our pup, Cino spayed and vaccinated as well as chipped. She was a medical rescue and very special to us. Laveen veterinary clinic took such great care of her,  and made us feel very warm and welcome.  Besides that, the clinic itself is absolutely beautiful. It looks like a spa inside! So very clean and tastefully decorated. If only we lived closer! I highly recommend this veterinary facility!

I took our dog Annie here for an annual exam and the staff was fantastic! We worked with Dani, Gabby, and Dr. Naig - all were wonderful and so patient with Annie. The building is beautiful and very clean!

I love the new office! Great job with the upgrades! Ive been bringing my pitbull here for the last 4 years and will continue to come back. The staff and vets are awesome, always friendly and patient 🙂

We brought our large, very rambunctious dog in for a knee issue.   Walking in the front door it very clean and spacious.   The front desk employee was very friendly.  The vet tech was so sweet and very informative.  Dr. Ware is awesome!  He explained things in terms we could understand and was so informative.  Overall ALL of the staff we met seemed compassionate and calming.   We will definitely be a regular.

Laveen Veterinary Center is an amazing, modern, and beautiful clinic with a warm and calming atmosphere. The moment you walk in, you can see how comfortable and relaxed the pets feel — unlike many other places where animals become nervous and stressed right away. That says so much about the care and environment they create there.

A very special thank you to Dr. Evan Were — a compassionate, understanding, and dedicated doctor who was truly born for this profession. Even outside of working hours, he finds a way to help during critical situations. In today’s world, it is rare to meet someone who puts humanity, care, and kindness before money. Even if you live far away, it is absolutely worth the drive to have a doctor like Dr. Were caring for your pets.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for everything you do for both animals and their families!
Ivory tower and expensive. That said the facility and staff are nice.

Crunchy $ and Lucky $ both enjoyed their visit to the LAVEEN Veterinary Center. They were greeted very nicely. Vet Technician Amy got to know them both. Dr. Aguilar did a thorough and very complete examination. They got their nails cut without any trouble or added stress. Thank you to the entire team. Crunchy and Lucky will be back. I appreciate the everyone’s kindness 😊

From the moment you walk in, the experience is calm, efficient and compassionate. The front desk staff is kind, communicative and always quick to respond to any questions or concerns. I truly appreciate how quickly they get you into a private room, minimizing time in the waiting area, which makes a huge difference for anxious pets like mine. The facility is very clean and well-maintained. My dog had a few accidents when we arrived, and the staff handled it immediately and kindly without making us feel uncomfortable. The exam rooms are clean, quiet and comforting.
I’ve interacted with multiple doctors here, and each one has had excellent bedside manner.. patient, attentive and informative. The vet techs are also wonderful, especially Christina, who stood out for her clear communication and genuine care.
Most recently, my dog developed a growth that turned into a large abscess and required surgical treatment. The entire process.. from assessment to surgery to follow-up was handled seamlessly. Everything ran on time, and I really appreciated the next-day follow-up from the doctor to check on his recovery. That level of attentiveness is so reassuring as a pet owner.. As a nurse myself, I also valued how they took the time to educate me and show me how to properly change my dog’s bandage at home. That trust and thoroughness meant a lot… i remember their previous, smaller location and I’m so happy to see their growth and expansion into a larger, beautiful facility.. it’s well deserved. I will absolutely continue bringing my pets here and highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate, reliable and high-quality veterinary care for their furry family members. Thank you

I just wanted to thank all of the staff for the kindness and the compassion that we were given as we said goodbye to our beloved cat of 13 years Grimm. We are still devastated due to the loss of our fur baby. But the staff here made the transition as gentle as possible.  I am very grateful for all of them.

Dr. Ware and his assistants gave our dog Copper excellent treatment for his luxating patella (loose kneecap).  Dr. Ware gave me a thorough explanation of the procedure and answered all my    questions before performing the surgery. Everyone on the staff was friendly and helpful pre and post surgery.  Copper is recovering nicely.

To be clear, my bad review is not because they hurt my animal. The vets are good and the services work.

I went in about a year ago because I got an at the time recently new cat. She was previously a stray, so I wanted to take her to a vet to get her vaccinated, spayed, checked for health problems, and possibly microchipped. Very basic. At the time I’d only barely started my job as a part time minimum wage cashier. I would spend anything to help my nee pet, but didn’t have that much. I was also ignorant and didn’t know that much about how much these should cost.

I spent over 1000$.

To just have an appointment at all cost 90$. Follow ups cost 50$

I got the vaccines. They were hundreds more than they are for the same ones at another place.

They checked her ears and said that they had a problem, so they gave me a large liter or so bottle of fluid to put in them and rub twice a day. The bottle cost, like, 50$, and the ear check in was also on the bill for a lot. By the time her problem went away basically none of the bottle was used and I still have this useless massive tube. I could have been given a very small amount instead, and it would have cost less

The said to spay her they would have to do bloodwork first to show that she would be fine. I agreed to it. They charged me like 300 for it, and said to do the spay, they need me to pay 250$ in advance. I did.

I got a phone call saying that she had something a little wrong with her blood, and that the supplements would cost 50$. I decided not to because the problem was mild, and there were ways to get her those vitamins that weren’t 50$.

I went in for the scheduled follow up, and they told me that, actually, I misunderstood that call. Because the blood was wrong, they couldn’t spay her (even though the problem had nothing to do with if spaying would hurt her). She actually needed anime 300$ of blood work to test if she could be spayed yet.

I already gave them around 100$ in advance.

They couldn’t use it to spay her, but I could use that around 100$ advance to pay for PART the appointment and the second round of bloodwork I was forced to do. I might have been able to get the advance back, but I still would’ve had to pay for that appointment so there was no use in getting a refund, as it would just go right back.

The new bloodwork said it was fine. I went to another clinic to get her spayed for 80$ instead of 500$. They also wanted 300$ for a microchip which I chose not to do.

I feel very bad about having lost so much money because I really didn’t have that much at the time. The last bunch of money for that second round of bloodwork and the completely useless 50$ appointment they didn’t actually tell me I should have canceled was completely wasted. I understand making your clinic more expensive to keep it open and pay the employees, but I felt scammed. I didn’t get an overpriced service, I got none and was still charged.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Sherry! We love caring for your pets!

Had a few good vets and one who blatantly didn't care. Unfortunately the one who didn't care was the one I was stuck with when my cat needed something more than just a check up. Sent me home with a cat who had an obvious bowel obstruction. She told us to wait for the radiology for something that requires fast action. Thank god I'm paranoid and immediately took him to an VEG and they immediately confirmed my suspicions and operated on him immediately. Be aware and advocate for your animal because some vets here WONT. I received a call from them at 10 am the next day being told to take him in immediately. What a joke. He was already post op 6 hours at that point.

We have been coming here about 2 years now and love the staff. Recently Dr Naïg did Nares surgery on our frenchie female and I couldn’t be happier! I feel the prices are very reasonable and not pressured to add services I don’t feel are necessary at that time. You have option to get meds from them or you can get through Chewy etc. you can also get written script for Costco, Sam’s or other pharmacy.
Laveen Vet Center has provided wonderful care and services and I will not go anywhere else. Thank you for taking great care of my babies ❤️
Thanks so much for the review, Jessica!
Very nice and clean the staff was awesome

I have an older Labrador who needed to have a minor procedure and had to be anesthetized. We we were worried given her advanced age but the team here was absolutely amazing. They took such good care of our Lab. If I could give 10 stars I would. Big thank you to the team and highly recommend them!!
The vets were very nice and helpful! They also provided a lot of important information. The office and waiting room were also very nice.
All of the Drs on this staff are very good at their jobs and extremely good with our pups.

I took my kitten Mochi here when she got hurt. It was super easy and quick to schedule the appointment online. Everyone from the time we walked in to meeting the Doctor help put me at ease. The Tech that was in the room was amazing but I was super impressed with the Doctor. She came in and did her assessment in the room and went over the treatment plan with me directly, instead of the Tech relaying messages back and forth.
Thank you again Dr Aguilar and all of the staff.
The people were nice enough but they charged me $500+ to assess my dog and draw blood but never made any follow up call to me with the test results. Very disappointed.
Love the office, it is very clean and beautiful. Staff is great and very professional. Thank you for the great care given to my fur baby

I brought my dogs to Laveen Veterinary Clinic because they were having trouble breeding.  All the staff was very professional and accommodating.  Dr Webber is very knowledgeable, open and friendly.  She was patient with all my questions and incredibly kind to my dogs.  She explained the plan well.  As we went through the process watching the team work together made me confident that I had chosen the right Clinic.  Opal, Sid and I are all very grateful!

Dr. Ware treated my dog and did her surgery.  He was able to save her back leg.  Other vets recommended amputation but I am really happy that she was treated at Laveen Veterinary Center.  She is doing great and recovering beautifully from surgery.

Between the Phoenix and Laveen locations we’ve been taking our 3 pets here for years, they used to be an amazing vet that was detailed oriented and care focused, overt the course of the last year or so something has drastically  changed,  maybe it was the splitting of staff to open the Laveen location, maybe is complacency, maybe it’s ineptitude, but over the course of specifically the last 6 months they have continually put my animals health at risk by not writing the correct prescriptions, whether they are not providing the correct dosages or messing up the prescription entirely (the re-wrote a prescription and then dosed it the dosage for one of their other prescriptions, they only have 2.) when i called twice over the weekend and left messages, those calls were left unreturned, when i finally called Monday  because i knew they were closed, 4 hours after they should have gotten my voicemails, while helpful, the front desk attendant was unapologetic. If this were a one off situation, no big deal, they corrected it and the medication was ordered but it’s not, it’s a continuous cycle of inadequacy. They literally have 2 sections each, how do you mess that up this often? The cause for this review is the most recent instance of them lying directly to me about calling in the dogs prescriptions, i took our Pitty in for annual bloodwork, Dr Ray was amazing and very helpful, upon leaving I realized that one of the prescriptions had no more refills, i called an was told they would call it in that evening, they did not, we had to call again the next day because it still had not been called in and they said they would again, we are at the pharmacy waiting.. but the question is, for someone who spent 1000’s at these two locations for the care of animals, when is enough enough? when does the continuous cycle of inadequacy and lying become a problem, today is the answer. Not only is it unethical to act in this manner as a vet, it’s borderline illegal to continue to put animals health in jeopardy because you cannot get 2 prescriptions correct.
Loved the attention and care. Super clean ! Super considerate ♡
First visit, great staff clean facility through exam done on our pup.
Great experience with bringing a new puppy. Friendly docs and nurses.

This is the second year I have taken my cat Winston in for his well cat check up to this vet center. First time in the new location. Everyone there, from the front desk,  to all the techs and the vet are marvelous. Very friendly and informative. My cat Winston loved going. Winston is a very outgoing, lovable cat, and he got all the attention he needed. 🙂
Very helpful.  Highly professional.  They made my new kittens feel right at home.

I took my dog copper here because he has a growth at the base of his tail. Long story short whenever this place tells you they’ll “call you with a quote” or if they tell you they’re gonna call you or send an email, they WONT. I’ve had to go to them TWICE to get the information I was promised. Now an hour before my dog is scheduled for a biopsy, is when they slam a surprise $1738 quote for his biopsy. This seems predatory and unprofessional. This is a reflection on how that whole office operates and I don’t trust them with my animal. This is why is so difficult to find a veterinarian that is trustworthy and actually CARES about your animal rather than just dollars.
Staff and Dr Ware are the best.   Always willing to help in anyway.
My pets love Dr. Naig. I am so glad we have found this place to care for them

I honestly thought i'd be lucky to see one of dogs live to 10. Everything from 2 acl tears, to a tumor, to skin cancer surgery, to gum surgery to valley fever.
My female is about to turn 10, she jumps on the back seat of the truck and on my high bed with no assistance, she is super active for hwr age which is about to be 10.
My male also got Valley Fever which one of the docs misdiagnosed. Dr. Ware came in and my male had recovered only six months later.
All thanks to Dr. Ware and i honestly mean it. U can tell he is an animal person right away. I have a 120lb male Am. Bulldog and an 84lb Am. Bulldog/ blluenose pit mix and the second he comes in they run to him and he just kisses them and hugs them.
I never leave reviews that might sound over the top and not genuine, but in this case i'd straight up be doing it an injustice if I held back in how highly I think of him. He is a genuine, knowledgeable and caring dude
So good with my girl, checked thoroughly asked questions and listened. Great team!

We are new to the Laveen Vet Center Family and we are so happy we switched. The vet tech Celeste and vet Dr.Aguilar are amazing! They are so personal and patient, they took their time to make my dog feel comfortable even though he was very anxious. We definitely found our new vet and couldn’t be happier.

Do not recommend! Revolving door of people, extremely expensive for the rushed experience that i got. The doctor barely touched my dog during the exam, and didn’t feel like my concerns were met. Honestly, disappointing.

I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Aguilar! She took such incredible care of my cat, Burger, and truly went above and beyond from the moment we walked in. She was gentle, patient, and so knowledgeable; Burger was instantly comfortable with her.
Dr. Aguilar explained everything clearly, answered all my questions without rushing, and made me feel completely confident in Burger’s care. It’s rare to find someone who is not only an expert but also genuinely compassionate, and she is absolutely both. You can tell she loves what she does, and it shows in every interaction.
If you’re looking for a vet who treats your fur baby like their own, Dr. Aguilar is the one. Burger and I are beyond grateful we found her!

The doctors and staff here take special care with your pets.  If you need a good orthopedic surgeon, Dr Ware is your guy.
You won’t be disappointed.

UPDATE:
I've been bringing my dogs to Dr. Ware for about 18 years now. His incredible skill, genuine empathy, and unwavering dedication to his patients — along with his wonderful staff — have always been outstanding.

The new Laveen Veterinary Center building (opened in April 2025) is absolutely beautiful and showcases Dr. Ware’s attention to detail everywhere — from the fun, welcoming exterior to the adorable mini bark park out back. There are also cat-only rooms, state-of-the-art surgical suites, and large, comfortable kennels. It perfectly reflects the care and thoughtfulness he brings to his practice.

Every visit reminds me why I trust Dr. Ware and his amazing team so much. Thank you all for the kindness, respect, and genuine compassion you show to both pets and their people — it truly makes a difference!
I love this place. They are always nice, they love my pets, and they do a great job at it. I've been with Dr. Ware for over 20 years and he's never let me down.
Beautiful office and caring staff!

I read so many positive reviews about Laveen Veterinary Center, and I truly wish ours had been the same. Unfortunately, it was not.

We brought in our 10-year-old Cane Corso, Nico, last week. His appetite had decreased, and his stomach was bloated and hard. The team did blood work, a physical exam, and a quick ultrasound. The vet mentioned something possibly "concerning" about his kidneys but said they’d wait for the blood work results before making any assumptions.

The next day, we got a call saying his blood work looked “unremarkable,” which we were told was a good sign. The vet recommended a more detailed ultrasound with a specialist, which we scheduled for that Thursday. After the ultrasound, I was told there was nothing concerning—just some gas in his intestines, possibly from not eating. They suggested trying an appetite stimulant and seeing how he did over the weekend. I was told, and I quote, “I’ll be on vacation, but I’ll call you on Monday to check in.”

At no point did I feel like my dog was in a critical state or that we were nearing the end.

Over the weekend, Nico didn’t improve. Monday came and went—no call. I called Tuesday morning to ask what the next steps were, but was told the doctor was on vacation and someone would text her. I called again in the afternoon and got the same response. I asked if the in-house doctor could call me, but was told she was booked.

That evening, I came home to Nico greeting me at the door—but not like he had the past 10 years. He couldn’t keep his back legs up. He was panting and clearly distressed. I immediately called the vet again and told them something was seriously wrong. I was again told the doctor was busy. I had to ask about emergency options myself. Only then was I texted a referral.

We rushed him to the emergency clinic. My last moments with Nico were heartbreaking—he was scared, stressed, and passed away alone in the back of my car. That’s my final memory of him.

I don’t believe the outcome would have been different. But I do believe, with better communication and urgency, Nico’s final moments could have been peaceful—at home, surrounded by the family who loved him.

The lack of follow-up, the poor communication, and the feeling that we were left on our own when we needed guidance the most was deeply disappointing. We will never return to this clinic.

As today, the vet has yet to call or send condolences.
The whole team was friendly and patient with my pup. The rooms were clean and check in was easy. The vet explained his treatment plan thoroughly and his skin is improving.
My dog is highly reactive and has difficulty getting his annual exam done. The staff were incredibly helpful and patient and we were able to get his exam done safely.
The sweetest staff!
Friendly professional staff.  Dr Velazquez was very detailed and explained everything thoroughly.  I will be back and will recommend

This is one of the best veterinary clinics in South Phoenix! My dog Reese’s had a severe mass and I went to many different places and this one and Phoenix Veterinary center were the only ones who gave my dog the treatment he deserved and removed the mass as a whole. No one can ever take that feeling away of knowing my dog was going to be okay. Dr. V is truly the best and my dog loves her and my family does too!

New facility is absolutely beautiful! This was my first visit with my very skittish Xolo.
EVERYONE was so kind!
We took our dog ducky in to be seen for an ear infection. Really good service staff is super friendly. They seem to genuinely care highly recommend for your furry friends.
Always my go-to vet for any issues. Always so nice to me and my dog!

I LOVE this vet. They always do really well with all my puppies. I come here from Chandler because I know my dogs will get the best care possible here with no out of this world expense. My dog had to get her TPLO removed because of an infection in her leg and they were so sweet and kind and they had the lowest prices out of all the estimates i got!!! If you’re looking for an outstanding vet this is the place!! i recommend them to all my family and friends. Dr. Ware is the best!!!

They handled all the family pets with gentleness. I haven't felt any pressure to get any procedures or medication done that I didnt feel we needed or financially couldn't afford at the time. The experience has been very calm and not stressful during any of my times here with my sick pets.
Injection and cold laser treatment. This has helped his aging hips.  The staff and Dr Ware are great to work with.

The compassion, patience, and love they give her (plus the dehydrated treats -- to be fair) put her straight into her happy place, even though she knows poking and prodding are imminent.

I can’t give ENOUGH stars to Laveen Veterinary Center.  On June 17th, I took my German Shepherd (VERY skittish) in to check on a bite wound he got while roughhousing with my other dogs.  The care they took with him, the calmness they displayed were wonderful!  After I checked out and was heading to my car:  the REAL story begins….

My dog lunged and slipped out of his collar and started running.  The ENTIRE STAFF came out and worked to chase him down so he wouldn’t get hit by a car on Baseline.  It took at least 45 minutes (and a pretty thorough tour of Laveen) before we were able to wrangle him.  By then he was suffering from heat stroke - so much so that when they brought him back to the clinic, his temperature was so high the thermometer couldn’t read it.  My dog’s life was in grave danger and THIS is really where this group shined… they got Krieger a cooled IV, ice bags, and everything else they could do to cool him down.  It was a horribly scary time for me, but the staff kept me informed with updates every 5-10 minutes.  They were able to bring his temp down with no permanent damage to him.

I would recommend this Vet Clinic to everyone!  You won’t find better care or more caring people anywhere.
